source: Hudl Instat ordinary goals/SOG/xG; separately retained CHN PP/PIM

definitions.xg: Hudl Instat xG against a goalie, all strengths: ordinary attempts facing a present opposing goalie, including PP, PK and extra-attacker offense. Attempts at an empty net are listed separately. Known sums retain unrated-attempt counts; partial totals are lower bounds, never complete estimates. The 5v5 option requires both goalies present. Historical CHN and current Instat probabilities use different models.
definitions.emptyNet: Goals for/against per game excluding goals scored INTO an empty net. Only games with both teams' goalie GA or complete scoring summaries reconciled to the final score are included. Extra-attacker goals remain included. Missing or conflicting goalie records are unknown; final-score records are unchanged. EN facts are CHN goalie records, joined to these released fixtures by date, both team IDs and both final scores.

scope: Countable D1 fixtures only; source fields retain their independent coverage. This explorer uses xG against a goalie at all strengths, with partial subtotals explicitly labeled and empty-net attempts separately retained. The 5v5 option requires both goalies present.
